title: Book One · Chapter 179: Time to Go Home
story:
At four, Miss Wu closes the outside door.

The room seems large again.

A little paper boat sits alone at the end of the table. Ronan picks it up and puts it with the others.

“We did it,” Leo says.

He sits on a chair and stretches his legs.

“My feet did it too. They are tired of standing here.”

Mei sits beside him.

“Mine want dinner.”

“Feet don’t eat.”

“Then why are they going home?”

Ronan laughs. He puts the empty box on the table.

Miss Wu asks everyone to choose a job. Some things must stay at school. People lent them some of the things. Those things must go back to their owners.

Mum takes the three light books out of her cloth bag and lays them in the carrying box. Then she folds the bag. She looks at the drawing beside it.

“Can this stay here a little longer?” she asks Mei.

“Yes. But I want it back later.”

“I will remember.”

Leo starts to lift the map.

Ronan holds up a hand.

“Wait. The paper bridge.”

They take it off first. Then they lift the map together. The folded corner is still marked, but the street names are clear.

Mei puts a sheet between two drawings. Ronan brings another box.

“Do we take all of this?”

“Some can go on the wall next week,” Miss Wu says. “I must ask the other teachers. Which wall can we use?”

Ronan looks at the door. Today is over, but some of the work will stay.

After his last customer has gone, Mr Qiu closes his own table for the day. He left the pencil box at school. Now he comes back for it.

“I can forget things without any help,” he says.

Leo hands it to him.

“We are good at finding things.”

“Today you are.”

Mr Qiu puts the box in his bag. Then he looks at Ronan.

“Your mum tells me you are looking for a bicycle.”

Ronan feels himself stand straighter.

“A used one.”

“I know a woman. She has a bicycle to sell. Her daughter is too tall for it now.”

“What colour?”

“Blue.”

Ronan does not answer at once.

He has thought of a red bike for a long time.

“How much?” Mum asks.

Mr Qiu tells her. She thinks for a moment.

“We can ask to look at it. We still need to check.”

“I will tell her.”

He does not promise the woman will keep the bike for them. She may sell it before they go. They must still ask the woman.

When the room is tidy, Leo's mother comes back as planned. She and Mum lift the stool. Ronan holds the school door. Leo and Mei walk with them as far as the gate.

“We should draw another street,” Leo says.

“Not tomorrow,” Mei says.

“I mean one day.”

“One day, yes. I want a rest tomorrow.”

They say goodbye.

Mum and Leo's mother carry the stool between them. Ronan carries the light bag and walks beside them. They stop at the narrow corner to let a woman pass.

At home, Mum puts it by the wall. Ronan looks at the corner of the shelf. His bell is there.

It is still there.

He touches it with one finger.

“Blue,” he says quietly.

Mum turns from the kitchen.

“We can look first.”

Ronan nods.

Then he goes to wash his hands. The school dust comes off in the water. There is still a small dark line beside one nail.

He washes that part once more.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- lend / lent：借给别人。
- stretch：伸展。
- tidy：整齐的。
- narrow：狭窄的。

## 理解
1. 展示结束后，哪些东西需要归还或继续保存？
2. 二手车的消息与“得到一辆车”有什么区别？
